scripts._preinstall_disabled_windows: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && cross-env PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter "@workspace/*" --filter "scripts" --if-present run typecheck
